102.name: Adventure EXP
102.description: Adventure EXP. Used to improve Adventure Rank.

105.name: Companionship EXP
105.description: Companionship EXP. Used to increase Friendship levels.

201.name: Primogem
201.description: A primordial crystalline gem that's beyond the mundane world. Shines with the condensed hopes and dreams of universes that once were.

202.name: Mora
202.description: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

221.name: Masterless Starglitter
221.description:
Currency used to purchase rare resources from the Shop.
Surplus Starglitter of destiny. Perhaps it can light up other corners of the universe.

222.name: Masterless Stardust
222.description:
Currency used to purchase rare resources from the Shop.
Surplus Stardust of destiny. Perhaps it can create new destinies when in large enough quantities.

223.name: Intertwined Fate
223.description:
A fateful stone that connects dreams.
Its glimmers can entwine fates and connect dreams, just as how its glimmers link stars into the shapes of a heart's desires.

224.name: Acquaint Fate
224.description:
A seed that lights up the night.
No matter the distance apart, guided by the stone's glimmer, the fated will meet under the stars.

239.name: Chronicle EXP
239.description: A witch's boundless collection, sealed within a Wonderland. Each treasure is a spark of inspiration leading toward a brand-new creation.

240.name: Chronicles of the Realms
240.description: Use this item to unlock Chronicles of the Realms for a single period.

301.name: Pyro Sigil
301.description:
A sigil representing the acknowledgment of Natlan's flames.
Can be offered to the Tablet of Tona at the Temple of Pax to obtain the blessings of the Sacred Flame.

302.name: Hydro Sigil
302.description:
A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the waters in Fontaine.
Offer it to the Fountain of Lucine to receive the rewards from the springs.

303.name: Dendro Sigil
303.description:
A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the trees, grass, and flowers in Sumeru.
Offer it to the Tree of Dreams deep in the woods to receive the rewards from the forest.

304.name: Electro Sigil
304.description:
A sigil that serves as a sign of the acknowledgment given by the thundering islands of Inazuma.
Offer them to the Sacred Sakura of the Grand Narukami Shrine to raise your Sacred Sakura's Favor level.

305.name: Anemo Sigil
305.description:
An insignia that shows the recognition of the winds of Mondstadt.
Can be exchanged for special items in Mondstadt.

306.name: Cryo Sigil
306.description:
A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the frost and snow of Snezhnaya.
Offer it to the Meeting Point to receive the rewards from the ice.

307.name: Geo Sigil
307.description:
An insignia that shows the recognition of the cliffs of Liyue.
Can be exchanged for special items in Liyue.

308.name: Luna Sigil
308.description:
A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the flowing moonlight of the borderlands.
Offer it to the Meeting Point to receive the rewards from moonlight.

1201.name: Gnostic Hymn - Old Notes
1201.description:
An early draft of a traveler's tale, recording the many things they saw on their journey across the lands. But why does it exist? It is almost as if you have been here before...

Use this item to unlock Gnostic Hymn for a single period.

1202.name: Blessing of the Welkin Moon - New Moon
1202.description:
A ritual prayer, recited on the rising of the first new moon, to ask for the moon's blessing in the form of wealth and good fortune. For your purposes, the new moon you shall pray to is the first-ever new moon in Teyvat, since it's the first one you've seen here.

Use this item to receive 30 days of Blessing of the Welkin Moon rewards.

100001.name: Apple
100001.description: Crisp and fragrant. Delicious raw or made into wine.

100002.name: Sunsettia
100002.description: A plump fruit, beautiful like the sunset, that is abundant across all of Teyvat. It has a curious, sweet aroma and is able to energize an individual.

100011.name: Mushroom
100011.description: Hardy common fungi. Can grow anywhere with the right amount of shade and moisture.

100012.name: Sweet Flower
100012.description: Particularly fragrant flowers. They can be found easily, even in the dark. Just follow the scent.

100013.name: Carrot
100013.description: A healthy and nutritious vegetable that is crunchy and sweet to the taste. Easy to grow and harvest.

100014.name: Radish
100014.description: Rich in fiber and nutrients. Easy to grow and harvest.

100015.name: Snapdragon
100015.description: Can be eaten once cooked. As a spice, it can bring wonderful flavor to dishes.
sources: Found near lakes and river banks

100016.name: Mint
100016.description: A refreshingly cool ingredient. The cool, fresh flavor can cut through the heat of many dishes.

100017.name: Wheat
100017.description: Golden, sun-kissed tassels. Needs to be ground down to flour for further use.

100018.name: Cabbage
100018.description: A layered, leafy vegetable. Said to have originally been an ornamental plant, it certainly looks great in the pot.

100019.name: Silver Lotus
100019.description: A rare plant that grows on steep cliffs with nobility. Shines magnificently in the night.

100020.name: Pinecone
100020.description: Filled with oil-rich seeds. Certainly won't be growing into a tree from inside a squirrel's stomach.

100021.name: Wolfhook
100021.description: A berry with thorns that often gets attached to a wolf's pelt. When you look at it, you can almost hear the echoing cries of the wolves in the woods.

100022.name: Valberry
100022.description: A plump and translucent berry that has a fragrant smell and a sweet, refreshing taste. In the past, the storm watchers' only solace was the sweetness of this fruit and hope for the city's peace.

100023.name: Cecilia
100023.description: A beautiful flower with a name that suits its appearance. It only grows where harsh winds blow, and is just as intangible as the true heart of an unbound soul.

100024.name: Windwheel Aster
100024.description: A plant that adores the wind. To the proud children of the wind, or the citizens of Mondstadt, the Windwheel Asters are "the visible winds."
sources: Found near the Statue of The Seven at Windrise

100025.name: Philanemo Mushroom
100025.description: A fungus that grows in the warm caress of the wind. It is as everlasting as the wind, nourishing life.
sources: Found under the eaves of houses

100026.name: Lotus Head
100026.description: An aquatic plant native to Liyue that grows and blooms in pairs. One is fragrant, and the other bitter. It's said to make a good herbal medicine.
sources: Found near lakes and river banks

100027.name: Jueyun Chili
100027.description: A spicy plant native to Liyue. Merely smelling it makes one hot and thirsty.

100028.name: Noctilucous Jade
100028.description: A rare mineral that glimmers in the dark. It's said to be a mutated gemstone condensed from the flourishing elements of the world.

100029.name: Silk Flower
100029.description: A crimson flower that blooms like the rainbow clouds in Liyue. It can be made into silky-smooth fabric.
sources: Found near Yujing Terrace, Liyue Harbor

100030.name: Glaze Lily
100030.description: An extremely ancient flower that was said to be commonly seen in Liyue. It transforms the memories of the land into its fragrance during florescence.
sources: Recommendation: Found in Yujing Terrace, Liyue Harbor

100031.name: Qingxin
100031.description: A translucent white flower that only grows on the highest stone peaks. It eschews the warmth and moisture of the plains to gaze out afar from the solitary mountaintops.
sources: Recommendation: Found in Guyun Stone Forest

100032.name: Horsetail
100032.description: A purple plant that sometimes grows amidst Silvergrass but grows taller, straighter, and plumper — like an aristocrat among the paupers.
sources: Found in patches of Silvergrass and wetlands

100033.name: Starconch
100033.description: Empty seashells brought ashore by the tides. Hold one close to your ear, and hear the longing calls of the sea.
sources: Found on the beaches of Liyue

100034.name: Violetgrass
100034.description: A small flower with strong vitality. It is said that its downward-blooming flower keeps its fragrance from dissipating.

100051.name: Berry
100051.description: Small, brightly-colored fruit. They can be found everywhere, and the taste of them wipes the fatigue of a long journey away.

100052.name: Mist Flower Corolla
100052.description: A flower bud encased in solid ice. Even after being picked, the flower continues to emit cold.

100053.name: Flaming Flower Stamen
100053.description: The stamen of a fiercely burning flower. Even after being extinguished, it still emits heat.
sources: Recommendation: Found at the Thousand Winds Temple

100054.name: Electro Crystal
100054.description: A power-rich crystal that draws electricity from the air around it. Holding it makes your hand a little numb.

100055.name: Small Lamp Grass
100055.description: A wild grass that emits light at night. Used in cooking to enhance other flavors.
sources: Recommendation: Found in the Whispering Woods

100056.name: Calla Lily
100056.description: A flower that grows near water sources. When cooked, the petals have a chunky texture, yet are sweet and a little bitter.

100057.name: Dandelion Seed
100057.description: A tiny seed that rides on the wind. Even without its feathered wings, it still holds the hope from afar within.

100058.name: Cor Lapis
100058.description: A precious crystal of condensed pure Geo element that usually grows along with other minerals. It's also commonly called "Cor Petrae."

100061.name: Raw Meat
100061.description: A fresh chunk of meat. Handled properly, it can be used to make delicious food.

100062.name: Bird Egg
100062.description: An incredibly versatile ingredient that can supply all of your daily protein needs.

100063.name: Matsutake
100063.description: A rare fungus that generally grows on or near pine trees. Its delicate aroma gives away its location.

100064.name: Fowl
100064.description: A fresh chunk of fowl. Handled properly, it can make a hearty meal.

100072.name: Butterfly Wings
100072.description: Brightly colored wings. The powder that falls from them shimmers a little. Perhaps this is what allows them to fly?

100073.name: Crab
100073.description: A shelled creature that lives near the ocean. Its flaky, delicious meat can easily be made into tasty dishes.
sources: Found near lakes, river banks, and beaches

100074.name: Crab Roe
100074.description: A delicacy specific to female crabs. A rare and prized ingredient that isn't quite to everyone's taste.

100075.name: Salt
100075.description: A savory seasoning. A precise but adequate amount will elevate the quality of the cuisine.

100076.name: Onion
100076.description: A spherical vegetable. As vengeance for cutting it, it will make you cry, no matter how brave you are.

100077.name: Pepper
100077.description: Peppery. Cuts through oily flavors and excites the taste buds. Goes best on meat.

100078.name: Milk
100078.description: Sweet and fragrant cow's milk. Don't waste a single drop, not even that one rolling down your chin.

100079.name: Tomato
100079.description: A bright red ingredient that gives a tangy kick. Yes, the "fruit or vegetable" debate is still going...

100080.name: Potato
100080.description: A chunky vegetable. A gift from the earth that you never tire of with its multitude of cooking methods.

100081.name: Frog
100081.description: Common frog found in moist environments. Full of energy, they secrete a substance that will keep you full of vitality.
sources: Found near bodies of fresh water

100082.name: Luminescent Spine
100082.description: The light-emitting part of a firefly. Used for courtship, and in medicine to help recover strength.

100083.name: Lizard Tail
100083.description: A lizard tail that curled up after losing its owner. Very bitter, but has skin hardening properties.

100084.name: Fish
100084.description: A fresh fillet of fish. Handled properly, it can make a rich dish.

100085.name: Crystal Core
100085.description: The core of a crystal butterfly. It absorbs elemental energy that has escaped into the atmosphere.

100088.name: Tofu
100088.description: Freshly made bean product that has a silky-smooth tender texture.
sources: Sold at general goods shops in Liyue
Sold at general goods shops in Inazuma
Sold at general goods shops in Sumeru

100089.name: Almond
100089.description: A seed with a peculiar fragrance that gives food a refreshing taste.
sources: Sold at general goods shops in Liyue
Sold at general goods shops in Fontaine

100090.name: Loach Pearl
100090.description:
A shiny pearl spat out by a loach that has mystical medicinal properties.
Minerals and elemental particles ingested by the loach condense into these mildly magical beads. When threatened, the loach spits them out to confuse predators and escape with its life.

100091.name: Bamboo Shoot
100091.description: A fresh young bamboo shoot, straight out of the ground. It is a delicious cooking ingredient with an exotic aroma, found exclusively in bamboo-growing regions.
sources: Recommendation: Found in the bamboo forest near Qingce Village

100092.name: Rice
100092.description: A grain crop commonly found in Teyvat. People of all walks of life enjoy its distinct grainy texture. As the saying goes, "The same kind of rice can feed one hundred kinds of people."
sources: Sold at general goods shops in Liyue
Sold at general goods shops in Inazuma
Sold at general goods shops in Sumeru

100093.name: Shrimp Meat
100093.description: A whole piece of deep sea shrimp meat, full of nutrients and bursting with delicious flavor.
sources: Sold at general goods shops in Liyue
Sold at general goods shops in Inazuma
Sold at general goods shops in Sumeru

100094.name: Chilled Meat
100094.description:
Rare, fresh meat.
This species of boar is recorded to have gone extinct several hundred years ago and has been preserved by the extreme temperatures on Dragonspine. For the gourmets of Teyvat, this is an ingredient of unspeakable sacrosanctness.

100095.name: Eel Meat
100095.description: The fresh meat of an Unagi/Eel. If handled properly, it can be used to make fresh, lovely food.

100096.name: Glabrous Beans
100096.description: A common legume in Teyvat with a light aroma. It can be prepared in a variety of ways, and is thus widely accepted by people all over the world.
sources: Sold at general goods shops in Fontaine
Sold at general goods shops in Natlan

100097.name: Mysterious Meat
100097.description: A fresh chunk of meat that seems to be radiating an enigmatic aura. Wonder what it'll taste like?

100098.name: Coffee Beans
100098.description: A common fruit in Teyvat with a special aroma. It can be used to make beverages after being ground.

100099.name: Fermented Juice
100099.description: A fermented juice with a unique fruity scent. It is often used as a marinade.
sources: Sold at general goods shops in Fontaine

100100.name: Rye
100100.description: The gray-brown ears are a gift from the earth. Their richness can only be brought out by grounding and roasting.
sources: Sold at general goods shops in Nod-Krai

100225.name: Hunting Trap
100225.description: Used to trap beasts of a certain size. If you pay attention in the wilds to collect them, you can make one like this. Set one down, and then conceal it carefully.

100618.name: Strange Tooth
100618.description: A Dragontooth you picked up in Dragonspine. Perhaps someone would know something more about it...

100619.name: Empowered Dragontooth
100619.description: A Dragontooth infused with power. Its luster and texture appear to have been somewhat transformed...

100934.name: Key Sigil
100934.description: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. Such pictures are used in unlocking, and are thus named "Key Sigils."

100935.name: Key Sigil
100935.description: A Key Sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. It was made by disassembling the emblems of the once-upon-a-time people of Byakuyakoku.

100936.name: Key Sigil
100936.description: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. Each of the five Key Sigils is unique in its structure.

100937.name: Key Sigil
100937.description: A Key Sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. When people left the ocean depths, they combined various Key Sigils to create the Sangonomiya house emblem.

100938.name: Key Sigil
100938.description: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. It conceals some secret.

101001.name: Iron Chunk
101001.description: This iron chunk can be turned into a multitude of handy items in the hands of a skilled craftsman.

101002.name: White Iron Chunk
101002.description: Skilled hands can make this into something brilliant.

101003.name: Crystal Chunk
101003.description: An uncut crystal. Only professional craftsmanship can bring out its true value.

101004.name: Magical Crystal Chunk
101004.description:
These crystal chunks can be refined into Weapon EXP materials by using Original Resin.
Crystals from mines that were eroded by the energy of the Ley Lines cannot be processed by ordinary means.

101006.name: Starsilver
101006.description: A rare and precious ore formed by the unique geographical conditions and Ley Lines of Dragonspine.

101008.name: Amethyst Lump
101008.description: An uncut crystal that can only be found in Inazuma. Some professional craftsmanship will bring out its true value.

101009.name: Condessence Crystal
101009.description: A bright and clear crystal with a core that is both tough and malleable.

101010.name: Rainbowdrop Crystal
101010.description:
A crystal that gives off an iridescent glow. Exceptionally tough and malleable, it has been regarded by Snezhnayan craftspeople as the best forging material since ancient times.
It is believed that when the moon's chariot was shattered, its blood-stained axle-tip fell into the earthly realm beneath the moon, transforming into an iridescent crystal. From that day on, the people of this land no longer worshipped the dead gods. The survivors who knew what the monarchs of the night died for, however, still futilely sing those long-forgotten names.

101101.name: Northlander Sword Billet
101101.description:
Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star swords. 
Philosophers believe marble has the potential to be sculpted into a beautiful statue. Likewise, these billets have the potential to become something greater.
sources: Reward for completing Trounce Domain Challenge in Mondstadt, Liyue, or Inazuma, or the Dominator of Wolves Challenge

101102.description:

101111.description:
Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star swords.
Philosophers believe that there are four purposes behind earthly things. The purpose of these billets is to become a weapon worthy of accompanying a hero.

101116.description:
Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star swords.
In terms of the "state" of the many weapons that can be crafted from billets, while their potential has long been contained within the original materials, the exact forms these weapons will ultimately take remain unknown to this day...

101201.name: Onikabuto
101201.description: A strange beetle that inhabits areas rich with Electro energy. Its docile and sedentary temperament could not be more different from the fierce, demonic visage displayed on its armored shell.

101202.name: Sakura Bloom
101202.description: Blossoms from the Sacred Sakura at the Grand Narukami Shrine, filled with a fondness for Inazuma.

101203.name: Crystal Marrow
101203.description: A crystal that contains a sliver of Tatarigami power. Adding this material during smelting will greatly increase the strength and toughness of metals.

101204.name: Dendrobium
101204.description: A vibrant plant that has also been named the "lycoris" by the poets. It was once thought extinct in the Inazuman archipelago, only to re-emerge now upon the battlefields. It is said that it blooms most enchantingly where much blood was spilled.

101205.name: Naku Weed
101205.description: Even on windless days, this plant will tremble lightly amid the cries of thunder. The parts of it that resemble petals are in fact extensions of the leaves meant to protect the fragile flower.

101206.name: Sea Ganoderma
101206.description: A plant species that only grows in certain regions and islands of the ocean. Though it looks like a fungus of some sort, it actually comes from a substance secreted by certain soft-bodied organisms.

101207.name: Sango Pearl
101207.description: A precious pearl that grows in the coral of Watatsumi. Gives off a cool sheen like that of the moonlight.

101208.name: Amakumo Fruit
101208.description: The fruit of the Amakumo Grass, which grows on Seirai Island. You can hear it crackling with a tiny current if you hold it up to your ear.

101209.name: Fluorescent Fungus
101209.description: A mushroom that glows like a night-light. Some curious power lies hidden within it.

101210.name: Seagrass
101210.description: A plant that grows in shallow seas. It adds a unique flavor to dishes.

101211.name: Lavender Melon
101211.description: A brightly-colored fruit. The flesh within transforms into food with a unique mouthfeel when cooked.
sources: Found in the wild in Inazuma

101212.name: Starshroom
101212.description: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It is quite hardy indeed. Once it matures, the center of the cap will split open.

101213.name: Rukkhashava Mushrooms
101213.description: A fungus that grows in layers upon layers, like a sea of clouds, and which mostly grows on trees deep in the rainforest.
sources: Recommendation: Found in the Ashavan Realm

101214.name: Padisarah
101214.description: A holy and noble plant. The conditions for growth in its environment are very demanding. The flower buds can be processed to make valuable spices.

101215.name: Nilotpala Lotus
101215.description: Growing in the forest wetlands, these plants only bloom at night with flowers as bright as the moon.
sources: Found at water bodies in Sumeru

101216.name: Harra Fruit
101216.description: Commonly grown in the hot and humid rainforest, this fruit has a special spicy aroma. When ground to powder, spices can be made from it. It is the most valued spice plant in Sumeru.

101217.name: Kalpalata Lotus
101217.description: Flowers from vines that grow on cliff sides. It is called a lotus only because it has a similar appearance to one. Aside from that, it bears no other similar properties to the lotus.
sources: Found in the mountains of Sumeru

101218.name: Zaytun Peach
101218.description: The fruit of a forest shrub. Its flesh is firm and sweet. It is said to have a calming effect on the mind.

101219.name: Sumeru Rose
101219.description: Bright and beautiful, these pure purple flowers give off a pleasant fragrance that will give any passerby pause. While some like to call this a type of "rambler rose," its relative lack of multiple flowers means that it falls under a different floral classification.

101220.name: Henna Berry
101220.description: A fruit that grows even in the most hostile of desert environments. Its vibrant crimson fruits are made even more lovely against a backdrop of yellow sand.
sources: Found in the deserts of Sumeru

101221.name: Ajilenakh Nut
101221.description: A fruit that grows on evergreen trees within desert oases. The flesh under the tough skin is thick, sweet, and delicious, making it an important food source amongst the desert peoples.
sources: Found in the desert oases of Sumeru

101222.name: Sand Grease Pupa
101222.description: You can only find such husks deep in the desert where the Quicksand Eels breed. The hardened shell is meant to protect the Quicksand Eels' larval bodies until they finally acclimate to the conditions of the dry desert.
sources: Found in the deserts of Sumeru

101223.name: Mourning Flower
101223.description: Crimson flowers that bloom on ancient battlefields. They can even flourish in the depths of the desert. Their drooping flowers seem to be in mourning for heroes long past.
sources: Found in the deserts of Sumeru
Recommendation: Found in the Asipattravana Swamp

101224.name: Trishiraite
101224.description: A splendorous stone that can be found in the depths of desolate mountains, seemingly formed from congealed elemental energy.
sources: Found in the deserts of Sumeru

101225.name: Scarab
101225.description: A tenacious beetle that finds repose within the vast ocean of desert sand. The golden pattern on such beetles' shells hints at some deep relationship between them and the ancient ruins that dot the desert.
sources: Found in the desert ruins of Sumeru

101226.name: Activated Starshroom
101226.description: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It seems to be bursting with vitality.

101227.name: Scorched Starshroom
101227.description: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It seems to be a little singed.

101228.name: Viparyas
101228.description:
A flower without seeds. 
Once the earth remembers, the Viparyas will bloom.

101229.name: Pluie Lotus
101229.description: A plant that grows in environments rich with Hydro. This plant can be found everywhere in Fontaine after its long rainy seasons. The plant is named "Pluie" — which means "rain" in the local tongue — for that reason.
sources: Found near lakes and river banks

101231.name: Marcotte
101231.description: A pink flower with a pearl-like luster and rich scent profile. It is one of the most important ingredients in a perfumer's arsenal.

101232.name: Beryl Conch
101232.description: A conch-like structure that gives off a faint glow. Despite the name, it is not a shell but something condensed from pure elemental energy.

101233.name: Romaritime Flower
101233.description: An ethereal and elegant blue flower. Its tender petals are elastic and water-absorbent, making it the ideal raw material for various daily necessities.

101234.name: Tidalga
101234.description: An algae floating with the tides that sustains itself by feeding on substances produced by other plants. Though often mistaken for zooplankton, based on its nature, Tidalga is actually a type of phytoplankton.

101235.name: Lumidouce Bell
101235.description: A serene and tranquil violet flower. It has a light, soft, and lasting scent and is often used for making luxurious perfumes.
sources: Found in the north of the Court of Fontaine

101236.name: Rainbow Rose
101236.description: A delicate and tender pink flower. Despite their name, Rainbow Roses are essentially more akin to Lilies.

101237.name: Lumitoile
101237.description: A soft-bodied animal that emits a gentle light. Often found climbing the walls of buildings near the water or underwater.

101238.name: Lakelight Lily
101238.description: A clear and clean azure flower, it is born where Water Veins come together. It has a simple, cool, and elegant fragrance, pungent and refreshing yet gentle.

101239.name: Subdetection Unit
101239.description: Detection units produced by Fontaine Research Institute using new models of artificed components. Its original purpose was monitoring all kinds of environmental data.
sources: Recommendation: Found in Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region

101240.name: Spring of the First Dewdrop
101240.description: A limpid drop of dew floating amidst the waters of Morte Region. It is different from other pure water bodies, as though it is a conglomeration of even more pure and primordial Elemental Energy.
sources: Recommendation: Found underwater in Morte Region

101241.name: Clearwater Jade
101241.description: Jade from Chenyu Vale. Named for its cool, refreshing touch, that is much like clear water.
sources: Recommendation: Found in Chenyu Vale: Southern Mountain

101242.name: Chenyu Adeptea
101242.description: Tea grown in warm, moist areas in Chenyu Vale. After millennia of careful cultivation, the tea today emits a rich fragrance that can be savored from several streets away.

101243.name: Grainfruit
101243.description: This plant is named after the giant grains that grow along the cob.

101245.name: Spinel Fruit
101245.description: The crystalline trees that grow widely in areas with Liquid Phlogiston produce these gem-shaped fruits after absorbing phlogiston.

101246.name: Cacahuatl
101246.description: A crop rich in flavor. The fleshy part itself features a unique bitterness and its seeds, after being fermented and baked, can be made into other delicacies.

101247.name: Sprayfeather Gill
101247.description: A special feather-shaped species that grows by the seaside. It looks kind of like a seagrass but is in truth a soft-bodied aquatic coral with a unique shape.
sources: Recommendation: Found near the "People of the Springs"

101248.name: Brilliant Chrysanthemum
101248.description: A flower with a shape like floating wings. Its petals sway in an unbelievably relaxed, serene manner as they are caressed by the wind.
sources: Recommendation: Found near the Stadium of the Sacred Flame

101249.name: Quenepa Berry
101249.description: Bluish, juicy berries that grow in large amounts near the Scions of the Canopy. Their shape is similar to that of Flamegranates.
sources: Recommendation: Found below the "Scions of the Canopy"

101250.name: Saurian Claw Succulent
101250.description: A succulent shaped like the paw of a great animal.
sources: Recommendation: Found in the Sulfurous Veins

101251.name: Embercore Flower
101251.description: A strange flower that can be found all over the plains and highlands. Mature buds will bloom after being hit.

101252.name: Glowing Hornshroom
101252.description: A fungus that emits a faint light in the darkness. It is so named because its shape resembles the horny crest of an Iktomisaurus.
sources: Recommendation: Found near the "Masters of the Night-Wind"

101253.name: Withering Purpurbloom
101253.description: A flower, the leaves and petals of which look scorched and withered, that can often be seen in places where ash abounds.

101254.name: Skysplit Gembloom
101254.description: A strange plant whose flower's exterior resembles stone. Only in bloom does it reveal a resplendent, crystal-like core.

101255.name: Dracolite
101255.description: Formed gradually in areas rich in Phlogiston, these red, scale-like crystals are blazing-hot to the touch.

101256.name: Red Berryshroom
101256.description: An ordinary-looking mushroom with an extraordinary flavor. Only grows near the orchard at Varesa's house. Since Paimon gave it a cute name, its taste must have been truly memorable for her.
sources: Recommendation: Found in the orchards of Atocpan

101257.name: Portable Bearing
101257.description:
A portable bearing of a type that was mass-produced after the Fatui moved into Nod-Krai. Excessively worn units are discarded like obsolete personnel.
A few of them have a vestige of kuuvahki left inside. As they are difficult to imitate, they are occasionally used as currency by merchants in Nasha Town.
It's said that people tried to forge these bearings for that reason, but went bankrupt in the end because the cost of forging them was higher than their market value.
sources: Recommendation: Found at the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop

101259.name: Icy Pebble
101259.description:
A pebble commonly found on Nod-Krai's coasts, characterized by a naturally occurring hollow. Touching it sends a faint chill through your finger.
According to ancient legends, the hollows in these pebbles were once shelters revealed to the fae by the Frost Moon — gateways to the ethereal. In another story popular in Nasha Town, the legendary thief, Reed Miller, was surrounded when a runestone given to him by a holy lady of the Frost Moon as a token of her love allowed him to conceal himself and escape his pursuers. Naturally, the Frostmoon Scions vehemently reject this claim, as these pebbles do not display any such magical properties.

101261.name: Frostlamp Flower
101261.description:
A flower that resembles a candle lamp, commonly found near water. It emits a cold, simple aroma that has a calming effect.
The contrasting colors of its stamen and stem are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, yet despite this symbolism, it is one of the few rare plants that are immune to kuuvahki's influence. As a result, the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as a symbol of faithlessness and apostasy.
It is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared at the end of the dark calamity five hundred years ago, but this claim has never been rigorously verified.
sources: Recommendation: Found in the Final Night Cemetery
Recommendation: Found near the Frostmoon Enclave

101262.name: Nocturnal Blossom
101262.description:
A flower in two entwined colors with a strong affinity for kuuvahki. Its light fragrance and conspicuous color have made it an excellent natural dye.
Its contrasting colors are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, so the followers of the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as the Moon Maiden's blessing.
It is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared decades after the dark calamity ended five hundred years ago, a claim widely reflected in the verses of the Frostmoon Scions, though it has never been rigorously verified.

101263.name: Moonfall Silver
101263.description:
A silver crystal as pure and pristine as moonlight. It possesses almost perfect elemental affinity.
In the legacy of the Frostmoon Scions, these crystals were born five hundred years ago alongside the Moon Maiden, and were believed by the Moonchanter at the time to be a gift from the moon, hence the name "Moonfall Silver". However, in older documents written by Snezhnayan chroniclers, the descendants of the golden realm were already using secret silver woven by the Frostmoon thousands of years in the past. The threads that connect these two tales are unclear — the only certain thing is that these crystals make excellent elemental conductors in the eyes of Nod-Krai's craftspeople.

101264.name: Lakkaberry
101264.description:
A fruit as white as pearl that tastes refreshingly sweet.
In the legends of the Frostmoon Scions, these fruits, like kuuhenki, are a gift from the Moon Maiden, a sacred symbol blessed by the new moon. Therefore, sharing and eating delicious Lakkaberries is also a form of worshipping Kuutar.
Even when not associated with the divine, their plumpness and sweetness alone are enough to awaken one's appetite.

101265.name: Midsommar Berry
101265.description:
A fruit that grows in the warmer parts of Nod-Krai. It is beloved by animals emerging from winter and hungry children alike.
In the legacy of the Frostmoon Scions, Midsommar Berries are regarded as a symbol of life and abundance, for they only flourish during the warmth of spring and summer.
There is a tale that tells of the endless struggle between the King of Winter Icelea and the King of Midsommar Oak — twin monarchs that slay each other as the seasons change, returning from the underworld to rule in turn until the end of time. Most Snezhnayan scholars dismiss this as a primitive religious metaphor for the alternating seasons — or at least that's what they tell themselves.

101268.name: Winter Icelea
101268.description: A hardy plant known for withstanding relentless wind and frost, it survives even in the coldest depths of winter.
sources: Found at the Pillar of Embla

101269.name: Pine Amber
101269.description: A gem formed from the resin of the towering ancient trees that once blanketed Nod-Krai. Over ages, the resin hardened into crystalline amber, now shining with vivid, radiant hues.
sources: Recommendation: Found near the Favonius Keep

101270.name: Teardrop of the Moon
101270.description: A clear, radiant azure crystal that holds an exceptionally pure form of kuuvahki. It possesses a near-perfect affinity with all types of elemental energy.

101271.name: Windrest Flower
101271.description:
An exquisite flower that remains delicate and fresh, found primarily in the northern part of Mondstadt.
Its fragrance is clear and enduring, making it one of the primary ingredients used in perfumery.

101272.name: Etherwing Moth
101272.description: A singular entity bathed in a divine, golden radiance, drifting through uncanny interstices as if a moth in flight.
sources: Recommendation: Found on Windrest Peak and Temple of Space
Recommendation: Found in Millhaven and the Pillar Hall Central Zone

101275.name: Frostfairy Flower
101275.description: A sacred flower that blooms no matter how harsh the wind and snow. It always radiates a faint, mesmerizing glow that draws the hearts of all who see it.
sources: Recommendation: Found in White Birch Snowgrave

101276.name: Flockingweed
101276.description: A peculiar plant once suspected to be a hybrid of plant and animal, though it was later proven to be nothing more than an ordinary plant covered in a coat of animal-like fuzz.

101277.name: Golden Fern
101277.description: A fern whose edges radiate a faint golden shimmer. It is said to take on a remarkably unique flavor when stewed.

101278.name: Red Beet
101278.description: A hardy herbaceous plant capable of thriving even in frozen soil. To survive such an unforgiving environment, it develops a thick, succulent root.

101279.name: Glaciafruit
101279.description: A star-shaped fruit born from Prime Ice that has undergone a peculiar transformation in the permafrost. Once the branch it grows upon is removed, the fruit falls naturally onto the snow.

101280.name: Snowball Flower
101280.description: A charming flower with a spherical cluster of petals. When snow settles upon it, the entire bloom looks just like a tiny snowball.

101281.name: Rimecurrant
101281.description: A richly flavored berry that sprouts from frost-rimed, icy branches.

101282.name: Lumifluorite
101282.description: A strange fluorite formed under the influence of the powers of the Shadow Realm.
sources: Recommendation: Found in Shadow Realms and nearby area

101301.name: Birch Wood
101301.description:
Timber obtained from birches. It is easy to work with and produces smooth cuts. Furniture made using such wood is both beautiful and durable.
Can be used to create furnishings.

101302.name: Cuihua Wood
101302.description:
Timber obtained from Cuihua Trees. With its lovely color and unique make, it will surely be able to take on myriad uses upon undergoing suitable workmanship.
Can be used to create furnishings.

101303.name: Pine Wood
101303.description:
Timber obtained from pines. Its color and grain are nothing to write home about, but its unpretentious nature is elegant in its own right. The wood is very sturdy as well. In able hands, its products should be able to resist moth and rot alike.
Can be used to create furnishings.

101304.name: Sandbearer Wood
101304.description:
Timber from the Sandbearer Tree. Said to be an exceptionally hardy plant resistant to wind and rain with a long lifespan.
Can be used to create furnishings.

101305.name: Bamboo Segment
101305.description:
Segments of bamboo that are light and far stronger than their humble appearance might suggest. It lets off a light fragrance.
Can be used to create furnishings.

101307.name: Fragrant Cedar Wood
101307.description:
Wood from the Cedar tree. Also known as the "Fragrant Cedar" for the aromatic oils it contains.
Can be used to create furnishings.

101308.name: Fir Wood
101308.description:
Wood from the tree known as "Faber's Fir." Widely used for its fine quality and attractive grain.
Can be used to create furnishings.

101309.name: Yumemiru Wood
101309.description:
Timber obtained from Sakura Trees. Exquisite in quality and full of moisture, people say that it can lull people into dreams as sweet as the warm spring.
Can be used to create furnishings.

101310.name: Maple Wood
101310.description:
Timber from the Amur Maple. Excellent quality wood with a fine color and texture.
Can be used to create furnishings.

101311.name: Aralia Wood
101311.description:
Wood from the Inazuman Cedar. It is soft, has straight veins, and gives off a light fragrance.
Can be used to create furnishings.

101312.name: Otogi Wood
101312.description:
Wood from the Otogi Tree. It has just the right amount of moisture and oil, and as such has a great many uses.
Can be used to create furnishings.

101313.name: Brightwood
101313.description:
Timber from the Brightwood Tree. It seems to have different properties from ordinary wood — soft but extremely resilient, easy to dye, and can be used for special purposes. 
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the forests of Sumeru

101314.name: Karmaphala Wood
101314.description:
The wood of the Karmaphala Tree. One can easily get a nice, smooth surface while working on this material and obtain a rather eye-pleasing result without going through any sophisticated processes.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the forests of Sumeru

101315.name: Adhigama Wood
101315.description:
The wood of the Adhigama Tree. Can be found everywhere and therefore appears rather ordinary, but the wood is durable and easy to handle.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the forests of Sumeru

101316.name: Mountain Date Wood
101316.description:
Wood of the Mountain Date Tree. Although it neither feels special to touch nor possesses a special texture, it retains water exceedingly well and is thus easy to grow.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the deserts of Sumeru

101317.name: Athel Wood
101317.description:
Wood of the Athel Tree. It has a special texture and is resilient to both drought and humidity, making it very durable.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the deserts of Sumeru

101318.name: Mallow Wood
101318.description:
Wood from the Mallow Tree. With a tough core, it is suitable for building the foundations and frames of houses. It is easy to craft and process, so it takes relatively less manual labor to produce beautiful furniture.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Fontaine

101319.name: Linden Wood
101319.description:
Wood from the Linden Tree. With a smooth texture and light color, few wood chips are produced even during fine processing. Often carved into delicate handicrafts or used to make compact parts for wooden mechanisms.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Fontaine

101320.name: Ash Wood
101320.description:
Wood from the Ash Tree. With its extremely high strength, it is not only used for making strong load-bearing components, but also for making sheets to be used as wall reinforcements, and for transportation crates subject to frequent shocks.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Fontaine

101321.name: Cypress Wood
101321.description:
Wood from the Cypress Tree. The core has a relatively large radius, with thinner sapwood. Though not solid or reliable as metal, the wood possesses unique advantages for buildings components with a large surface area.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Fontaine

101322.name: Torch Wood
101322.description:
Wood from the Torch Tree. It has a soft texture, can be easily cut, stays dry easily, and the color is compatible with many bright paints. This makes it a common choice for artisans making delicate decorations.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Fontaine

101323.name: White Chestnut Oak Wood
101323.description:
Timber obtained from White Chestnut Oak Trees. It strikes a balance between hardness and toughness, making it easy to process. Though it appears no different from most other wood, its color grows lighter once processed using methods common to the tribes of Natlan, becoming nearly white, hence the name.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Natlan

101324.name: Ashen Aratiku Wood
101324.description:
Timber obtained from Ashen Aratiku Trees. Other than being lighter, it isn't all that different from most regional trees in Natlan. Mature Saurian companions can carry it with ease, and some legends even tell of tribal warriors who use bundles of such timber as fitness gear.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Natlan

101325.name: Flammabomb Wood
101325.description:
Timber obtained from Flammabomb trees. Unlike what their names suggest, such timber is resistant to catching fire or exploding once processed using methods recommended by the Collective of Plenty.
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Natlan

101326.name: Peach Palm Wood
101326.description:
Timber from Peach Palm Trees. As the name suggests, the bark has the feel of coconut palm husks, and is both smooth and aesthetically pleasing once sanded and polished, with exceptional hardness and humidity-resistant qualities...
Can be used to create furnishings.
sources: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Natlan

101327.name: Silver Fir Wood
101327.description: Wood harvested from the Silver Fir Tree. Humans have favored this type of wood since ancient times for its wide range of uses, from crafting barrels to constructing frameworks.

101328.name: Hazelnut Wood
101328.description: Wood sourced from the Hazelnut Tree. Though the subspecies this wood comes from vary wildly in appearance, they mostly share the same unique compounds that offer excellent resistance to insects and decay, making it a remarkably durable material.

101329.name: Pedunculate Oak Wood
101329.description: Wood sourced from the Pedunculate Oak Tree. While its density is relatively low, it boasts impressive toughness and water resistance, making it a common choice for buildings near bodies of water.

101330.name: Alder Wood
101330.description: Wood from the Alder Tree. It demonstrates considerable resistance to moisture and cold, making it a fine raw material for both furniture and musical instruments.

101331.name: Snow Poplar Wood
101331.description: Wood from Snow Poplars that have smooth surfaces and light, soft textures. A fine choice for making all sorts of small woodworking products...

101332.name: White Birch Wood
101332.description: Wood from White Birches that boasts high density and toughness. Used for building structures for which bending resistance is a necessity...

101333.name: Bluebeech Wood
101333.description: Wood from Bluebeeches with even grain patterns that can better withstand wear and tear. In Snezhnaya, it is often used in layered panels involved in structures and implements for long-term use.

101334.name: Larch Wood
101334.description: Wood from Larches. They possess considerable hardness and are highly corrosion-proof. Snezhnayans often use it to build pillars and boards.

101401.name: Fabric
101401.description: Some fabric of fine make. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

101402.name: Red Dye
101402.description: Red dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

101403.name: Yellow Dye
101403.description: Yellow dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

101404.name: Blue Dye
101404.description: Blue dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

101644.name: Lumenstone Ore
101644.description: The raw ore from which Lumenstone may be found. If processed properly, it can be used to strengthen the Lumenstone Adjuvant you have. Why not hit Jinwu up and ask her?

101692.name: Light Realm Sigil
101692.description:
A mark symbolizing the recognition of Enkanomiya's Tokoyo Ookami.
They can be offered up to the Statue of the Vassals of Watatsumi, thus upgrading the Bokuso Box.

101693.name: Light Realm Core
101693.description:
You discovered this mysterious stone while exploring the darkened realm of Enkanomiya.
The Light Realm gave humans additional means to resist the Abyss.

101714.name: Fragrant Seasoning
101714.description: Seasoning created using the recipe given to you by Nazafarin. It has a tangy aroma and serves to bring out the flavor in any dish it is added to.

104001.name: Wanderer's Advice
104001.description:
Character EXP material. Gives 1,000 EXP.
These experiences are still beneficial even if one does not live in Teyvat.

104002.name: Adventurer's Experience
104002.description:
Character EXP material. Gives 5,000 EXP.
These experiences are very beneficial for journeys into the unknown.

104003.name: Hero's Wit
104003.description:
Character EXP material. Gives 20,000 EXP.
These experiences are extremely precious for a pilgrim traveling through Teyvat in order to be closer to Celestia.

104011.name: Enhancement Ore
104011.description:
Weapon EXP material. Gives 400 EXP.
A refined ingot with endless possibilities that can be used to enhance weapons.

104012.name: Fine Enhancement Ore
104012.description:
Weapon EXP material. Gives 2,000 EXP.
For reasons unknown, this special and refined ore can be absorbed by weapons to greatly increase their strengths.

104013.name: Mystic Enhancement Ore
104013.description:
Weapon EXP material. Gives 10,000 EXP.
Legend has it that this refined ingot contains the memories of battles that had taken place in the land. The weapons that benefit from these memories naturally become sentient.

Character Ascension material.
"The currencies that flow through this land are my flesh and blood."

104173.description:
Character Ascension material.
"The currencies that flow through this land are my flesh and blood.
For thus did I become the guarantor of the people's hard work, wisdom, and future."
sources: Check the Enemies Tab in the Adventurer Handbook

104174.name: Prithiva Topaz Gemstone

Character Ascension material.
"The currencies that flow through this land are my flesh and blood.

This is the trust I have placed in them. Betray it, and you taint my blood."

104201.name: Dust of Azoth
104201.description:
A device that can transmute elemental Ascension Materials and change their Elemental Type.
Its practical uses notwithstanding, alchemy is the study of the nature of matter and the rules that underpin its transformations, and ultimately it seeks to comprehend the working principles of the world and the flow of the ley lines.
It is not known who would share alchemical achievements of this magnitude with the civilizations of the world and why. But although the power to fundamentally transmute elemental energy in its crystallized and inert form is a highly useful one, this device also conceals the grave danger of disrupting the elemental balance...

104301.name: Teachings of Freedom
104301.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Freedom is the spirit of the land of the wind.
The freedom to live is one of such. It is the freedom to live freely and healthily without concerns of one's own safety.

104302.name: Guide to Freedom
104302.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Freedom is the spirit of the land of the wind.
The freedom of travel is one of such. It is the freedom to traverse the land freely without being obstructed.

104303.name: Philosophies of Freedom
104303.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Freedom is the spirit of the land of the wind.
To sing is one such freedom. To sing on the land created by the Anemo Archon is to send your heart away with the song on the wind.

104304.name: Teachings of Resistance
104304.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Resistance is the backbone of the land of the wind.
The history of Mondstadt is one of resistances. People rose up to prevent past conflicts from ever being forgotten, like sprouts breaking through the soil, like the eternal wind eroding through stone walls.

104305.name: Guide to Resistance
104305.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Resistance is the backbone of the city of Wind.
The history of Mondstadt is one of resistances. People rose up to grant the citizens of Mondstadt the freedom they now enjoy, like the Anemo Archon blowing away the snow, or like Vennessa rising up to fight.

104306.name: Philosophies of Resistance
104306.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Resistance is the backbone of the land of the wind.
The history of Mondstadt is one of resistances. People rose up to allow the future Mondstadt's poetry to freely be that of the wind and be spread across the land.

104307.name: Teachings of Ballad
104307.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Poetry is the soul of the land of the wind.
Poetry is the manifestations of beautiful feelings. On a beautiful day, the breezes carry with them poetry that touches the heart of people like the wind caressing the leaves.
104307.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Realm of Slumber

104308.name: Guide to Ballad
104308.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Poetry is the soul of the land of the wind.
Poetry is the manifestations of the will to encourage. In the dark days, the gales in the streets and alleyways whisper words of fury, like the battle drums, like the low rumbling before the storm.
104308.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Realm of Slumber

104309.name: Philosophies of Ballad
104309.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Poetry is the soul of the land of the wind.
Poetry is the manifestations of the desire to spread the word. Though nothing is eternal, though nothing will be the same, the wind's poetry will still spread beyond the skies, the land, the seas to every corner of the world.
104309.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Realm of Slumber

104310.name: Teachings of Prosperity
104310.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Prosperity is the people's pursuit in the land of Geo.
Prosperity is the blessing of Liyue, it is the foundation of the great city built by the gods and the people of Liyue, and it is the source of the peace and safety of the land.
104310.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Altar of Flames

104311.name: Guide to Prosperity
104311.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Prosperity is the people's pursuit in the land of Geo.
Prosperity is the promise made by Liyue to its children: To repay the hard-working laborers with enough gold to brighten up this land.
104311.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Altar of Flames

104312.name: Philosophies of Prosperity
104312.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Prosperity is the people's pursuit in the land of Geo.
Prosperity is Liyue's past, present, and future. This prosperity is unmatched and unobtainable by any other nations — it all belongs to Liyue and its inhabitants.
104312.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Altar of Flames

104313.name: Teachings of Diligence
104313.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Industriousness is the foundation of the land of Geo.
Diligence is having the bravery and the strength to conquer mountains and seas and to pursue gold and prosperity through honest, hard work.
104313.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Heart of the Flames

104314.name: Guide to Diligence
104314.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Industriousness is the foundation of the land of Geo.
Industriousness is the catalyst that flows in the blood of the people of Liyue, able to turn rocks into gold. It is what lies behind the greatness of its great commercial port.
104314.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Heart of the Flames

104315.name: Philosophies of Diligence
104315.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Industriousness is the foundation of the land of Geo.
Industriousness is believing in one's own ability to earn a place in the land of the gods through sweat, wisdom, and power.
104315.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Heart of the Flames

104316.name: Teachings of Gold
104316.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Gold is the symbol of the land of Geo.
Gold is the blood that flows deep within Liyue's veins, the muscle that makes up Liyue's beating heart, and the bones that make Liyue stand proud.
104316.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Circle of Embers

104317.name: Guide to Gold
104317.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Gold is the symbol of the land of Geo.
Gold symbolizes conversion. This is the unspoken understanding between Liyue's mountains, land, city, and people. In Liyue, industriousness is converted into gold, and gold into prosperity.
104317.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Circle of Embers

104318.name: Philosophies of Gold
104318.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Gold is the symbol of the land of Geo.
Gold is the wealth of Liyue, but Liyue's true wealth is the hearts of its people that shine like gold.
104318.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Circle of Embers

104319.name: Crown of Insight
104319.description:
A precious Talent Level-Up material.
Once a medium for the storage and transfer of wisdom in ancient times. Now, wisdom is found in ancient texts and in profound speech. Nevertheless, this Crown of Insight must still be able to impart some transcendent power and wisdom to its bearer.

104320.name: Teachings of Transience
104320.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Transience is the dream of the nation of thunder.
Fleeting glories are the highest expression of mortal beauty, for are we mortals not like the flashing lightning itself? Like a lovely dream or blossoming spark, we shall leave a gorgeous mark on the eternal night sky.
104320.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Reign of Violet

104321.name: Guide to Transience
104321.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Transience is the dream of the nation of thunder.
We find the greatest joys in mortal life in transient dreams, for is life itself not like the shadow of the thunder? Pursue your dreams into the clouds if you wish, and enjoy the unexpected silence of the dim lamp-lit nights.
104321.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Reign of Violet

104322.name: Philosophies of Transience
104322.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Transience is the dream of the nation of thunder.
The fleeting nature of this mortal world is the essence of beauty, for are our lives in this world not akin to the levin flash? Yet the might of the divine comes suddenly, and before the roar of eternity, who can stand?
104322.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Reign of Violet

104323.name: Teachings of Elegance
104323.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Elegance is the form of the nation of thunder.
Elegance brooks no flattery, and the elegant are ever noble. They are like the sea eagles who soar on high to contend with the resounding storms. They will not cater to philistine vulgarity, as one would not cast a flower crown into the mud, staining its dignity.

104324.name: Guide to Elegance
104324.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Elegance is the form of the nation of thunder.
Elegance shuns arrogance. The elegant are ever humble, and only by discarding vanity and sloth may one see clearly — and is there not beauty and loveliness even in the basest of appearances?

104325.name: Philosophies of Elegance
104325.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Elegance is the form of the nation of thunder.
Elegance abhors vulgarity, and the elegant ever walk alone. Resisting base evils, unmoved by base loves, never taking refuge in base ignorance — that is how one perceives the chasm between the elegant and the contemptuous.

104326.name: Teachings of Light
104326.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Light is the yearning of the land of thunder.
The ruler who claims to have perceived all forever aims to hoard celestial glory. But this vision that cannot be shared only leads people to long for it more fiercely, like moths diving into the flame.

104327.name: Guide to Light
104327.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Light is the yearning of the land of thunder.
Though the sun rays themselves should be blocked by layers upon layers of clouds, there are still those in the thunder god's land who dream of piercing that wrathful sea of lightning to pursue the glory of the divine, fearing not that they shall be cruelly struck down.

104328.name: Philosophies of Light
104328.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Light is the yearning of the land of thunder.
Though they must live forever on the earth, humanity will always reach for the light. Mortals will pursue and surpass, and they will never stop. A sealed eternity may, perhaps, look magnificent, but its essence is death.

104329.name: Teachings of Admonition
104329.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Admonition is the branches of the nation of wisdom.
Admonition comes from a pure heart. Only sensible words of goodwill can express profound wisdom and free the sprout of knowledge from the shackles of arrogance.

104330.name: Guide to Admonition
104330.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Admonition is the branches of the nation of wisdom.
Admonition is paired with wise thinking. Careful deliberation affords humble words a clarity that convinces the wise and enlightens the foolish. Such words allow wisdom to flow like an unobstructed river.

104331.name: Philosophies of Admonition
104331.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Admonition is the branches of the nation of wisdom.
Admonition is completed by good deeds. What is done confers real meaning upon what is said. When one's mind, words, and deeds are aligned, their nourishment shall guarantee the fruition of wisdom's tree.

104332.name: Teachings of Ingenuity
104332.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Ingenuity is the leaf-veins of the nation of wisdom.
Ingenuity springs forth from benevolent consideration. They say that "a poisonous tree bears no kind fruit." Similarly, ingenious nascent ideas are always born from determined and benign minds, for only they are worthy bearers of wisdom.

104333.name: Guide to Ingenuity
104333.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Ingenuity is the leaf-veins of the nation of wisdom. Ingenuity sets words of integrity on the right path. One who thinks out of goodwill and in a clever and careful fashion never deviates from the path of boons. Yet one who thinks with contempt and malice shall taint their words with despicable colors.

104334.name: Philosophies of Ingenuity
104334.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Ingenuity is the leaf-veins of the nation of wisdom.
Ingenuity is completed by harmonious conduct. What is done completes what is thought. Wisdom blooms where the mind, words, and practice converge.

104335.name: Teachings of Praxis
104335.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Praxes are the roots of the nation of wisdom.
Praxes stem from an unwavering will. All wisdom is manifested through the unyielding pursuit of goodness. Where goodness is not practiced, ingenuity and eloquence wither.
104335.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Basket of Discipline

104336.name: Guide to Praxis
104336.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Praxes are the roots of the nation of wisdom.
Praxes validate words of honesty. Though one speaks and acts out of goodwill, one has not yet obtained wisdom. Wisdom, born from action, is a signet pressed upon honest words.
104336.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Basket of Discipline

104337.name: Philosophies of Praxis
104337.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Praxes are the roots of the nation of wisdom.
Praxes bring forth the fruit of wisdom. Practice grants itself meaning, and it is only by treading a path that unites action, speech, and thought that the wise may reach perfection.
104337.domainName: Domain of Mastery: Basket of Discipline

104338.name: Teachings of Equity
104338.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
The shore of the Nation of Water is equity.
Equity sets boundaries on rights. Without equity, the rights granted by law will be abused, and become a tool to damage our virtuous customs.

104339.name: Guide to Equity
104339.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
The shore of the Nation of Water is equity.
Equity is the foundation upon which Fontaine was founded. Equity forms the standard of the law. If law loses the essence of equity, it will become a chessboard played for profit.

104340.name: Philosophies of Equity
104340.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
The shore of the Nation of Water is equity.
Equity is the foundation upon which Fontaine was founded. Equity requires the continuous and steady support of morality and law, and morality and law constantly change based upon the invariant principle of equity.

104341.name: Teachings of Justice
104341.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
The sword of the Nation of Water is justice.
The law of Fontaine walks with the sword of justice in hand. Without the guidance of justice, all law is reduced to meaningless words, to be tampered with and slaughtered at a whim.

104342.name: Guide to Justice
104342.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
The sword of the Nation of Water is justice.
The law of Fontaine walks with the sword of justice in hand. Justice must be blind, and those who wield the sword of justice must not be led astray by their own interests or affairs.

104343.name: Philosophies of Justice
104343.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
The sword of the Nation of Water is justice.
The law of Fontaine walks with the sword of justice in hand. Justice means judgment and reconciliation, the blade of judgment arrests the actions of evil, while reconciliation maintains order.

104344.name: Teachings of Order
104344.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
The shield of the Nation of Water is order.
All law in Fontaine ultimately serves to maintain a stable order. Without order, there is chaos, and there can be no fairness in chaos.

104345.name: Guide to Order
104345.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
The shield of the Nation of Water is order.
All law in Fontaine ultimately serves to maintain a stable order. Without the guarantee provided by order, justice will be reduced to unlimited violence, a weapon used by all against all.

104346.name: Philosophies of Order
104346.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
The shield of the Nation of Water is order.
All law in Fontaine ultimately serves to maintain a stable order. Equity and justice come from order, and serve order. Like the still, ripple-less surface of the waters of Fontaine, order is the cornerstone of Fontaine's existence.

104347.name: Teachings of Contention
104347.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Contention is the principle by which all is weighed in the Nation of Pyro.
What defines strength, and what weakness? Only victory and defeat. The results of a contest are more convincing than any words.

104348.name: Guide to Contention
104348.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Contention is the principle by which all is weighed in the Nation of Pyro.
Though humans cannot fly at the speed of winged beasts, nor match the flexibility of slimes, yet still, they have their own unique strengths. Sometimes, understanding both why and how to compete is the key to knowing oneself.

104349.name: Philosophies of Contention
104349.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Contention is the principle by which all is weighed in the Nation of Pyro.
Its purpose is to make yourself stronger. After the outcome of a competition has been decided, the victor gains the confidence to be sure of their direction, while the loser gains insights on how they must become stronger. Beyond winning or losing, this is the true meaning of contention.

104350.name: Teachings of Kindling
104350.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Offering up kindling is the established rule of the Nation of Pyro.
For something gained, something must be given. If you wish to obtain something, you must first pay the corresponding price, just like the offerings that should be made as kindling in the process of incineration.

104351.name: Guide to Kindling
104351.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Offering up kindling is the established rule of the Nation of Pyro.
To acquire a certain amount of something, one must first pay the corresponding price. Sometimes, you may end up paying too much to obtain something; while other times, you may pay too little, and lose it as a result. Understanding how to strike this balance between giving and receiving is one of the meanings of offering kindling.

104352.name: Philosophies of Kindling
104352.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Offering up kindling is the established rule of the Nation of Pyro.
What is meant by offering kindling is to offer up a sacrifice before one obtains something, though it does not always guarantee a response or return. Its true meaning lies in paying a price without expecting a reward — for in the end, the day when the fruits will be reaped is sure to come.

104353.name: Teachings of Conflict
104353.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Conflict is considered reason in the Nation of Pyro.
Rather than avoiding conflict, one should face confrontations head-on. Once the outcome has been made manifest, the path forward should be determined accordingly.

104354.name: Guide to Conflict
104354.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Conflict is considered reason in the Nation of Pyro.
Conflicts can always be resolved by greater powers. This fact means that they can always be managed, as opposed to developing into something uncontrollable. Conflict is also a kind of limitation, preventing people from endless shirking of responsibilities without weighing the costs. It demands that participants settle their scores decisively and efficiently.

104355.name: Philosophies of Conflict
104355.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
Conflict is considered reason in the Nation of Pyro.
The premise of conflict is that all parties involved must confront their own desires with the utmost sincerity. Only then, amid the fight or debate, can they remain mindful of what they wish to achieve and stay true to their original objectives.

104356.name: Teachings of Moonlight
104356.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
"Moonlight" is the blessing of the land beneath the moon.
Things come in all sizes, and people come in all states of wisdom. Yet under the moonlight, all are equal.

104357.name: Guide to Moonlight
104357.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
"Moonlight" is the blessing of the land beneath the moon.
The cloud-veiled moonlight glows but faintly over the boundless dark wilds. Yet its fragile glimmer is a guide through the endless night.

104358.name: Philosophies of Moonlight
104358.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
"Moonlight" is the blessing of the land beneath the moon.
Praying to the new moon for guidance and fortune is a rite passed down from the days of the first people. Tonight's moonlight seems no different from any other night, yet where is the new moon that people once looked to?

104359.name: Teachings of Elysium
104359.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
"Elysium" is the dream of the land beneath the moon.
There are those who are desperate to get in, and those who are desperate to get out. Perhaps Elysium is not a place one can ever truly reach.

104360.name: Guide to Elysium
104360.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
"Elysium" is the dream of the land beneath the moon.
To create a paradise without borders or distinctions upon a land overflowing with bitterness and sorrow — though it might be but a childish delusion, it may yet be a foundation for the future.

104361.name: Philosophies of Elysium
104361.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
"Elysium" is the dream of the land beneath the moon.
Seldom do we share the same dreams of paradise. For those who wish not to settle for the present, there is no greater paradise than Nod-Krai. Yet for all the rest, the truth is quite the opposite.

104362.name: Teachings of Vagrancy
104362.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
"Vagrancy" is the living of the land beneath the moon.
Enjoy a moment's respite, then depart before the sky turns black. Dawn is not the end, but the beginning of another journey.

104363.name: Guide to Vagrancy
104363.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
"Vagrancy" is the living of the land beneath the moon.
To live is to wander, for none of us can settle in this world. What is remembered is not the moment of arrival, but the footprints that we leave along the way.

104364.name: Philosophies of Vagrancy
104364.description:
Talent Level-Up material.
"Vagrancy" is the living of the land beneath the moon.
Through thunder and storms, across mountains and snowfields, though scarred and weary, the wanderer does not stop — nor will they till they find a place to call home.

104365.name: Teachings of Charity
104365.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Charity is the salvation of the frozen realm.
It is the love and vigilant care shared among mortals. Across this vast and boundless land, it is the warmth by which the people withstand the biting frost, soothing the deep-seated scars etched into their memories.

104366.name: Guide to Charity
104366.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Charity is the salvation of the frozen realm.
It breeds mercy for others. In the realm of wind and snow, whosoever sincerely repents for the sins of their soul shall find absolution in the name of Charity.

104367.name: Philosophies of Charity
104367.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Charity is the salvation of the frozen realm.
It is a boundless grace extended to all living things. It collapses the divide between the highborn and the low, transcending both bloodline and nation. Its watchful gaze beholds all of humanity, offering sanctuary to the unfortunate and promising eternal liberation unto all.

104368.name: Teachings of Fortitude
104368.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Fortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.
It stems from a raw yearning for survival. Even if scattered far from fertile soil, a fragile seed can rely on this desperate longing to drive its roots deep beneath the frozen tundra.

104369.name: Guide to Fortitude
104369.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Fortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.
It brings forth the will to grow. Though shattered by the bitter cold, a fragile seed can still harness this will to break through the frozen earth, pushing forth fresh sprouts to life across a landscape blanketed in wind and snow.

104370.name: Philosophies of Fortitude
104370.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Fortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.
It breeds the prosperity of life itself. The people here have never bowed to the biting cold, just as a fragile seed defiantly chooses to bloom amidst the blizzards. This civilization has witnessed centuries of bitter winter, yet remains vibrant much like the Frostfairy Flower that flourishes season after season.

104371.name: Teachings of Glory
104371.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Glory is the sacred faith of the frozen realm.
It is a spark buried deep beneath the frozen soil; if one can but trace its true form, they shall grant themselves the courage to stand against the biting cold.

104372.name: Guide to Glory
104372.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Glory is the sacred faith of the frozen realm.
It is an ember flickering in the deep night, a beacon upon which all who trek across the snowfields fix their gaze. Just as they are certain the blizzards will wane and the dawn will break, they are certain that the path they tread remains the true one.

104373.name: Philosophies of Glory
104373.description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Glory is the sacred faith of the frozen realm.
It is the undying flame upon the beacon hearth, bound now to live or die with the frozen realm. The flame ignites a noble passion, and to sustain its eternal burn, the people would gladly offer up their all.

105005.name: Sanctifying Elixir
105005.description:
A material that is consumed when defining Artifacts with the Artifact Transmuter.
Artifacts are themselves the crystallized physical manifestation of ideals and memories. This is one of the applications of the noble art of Alchemy — namely, to preserve ideals by crystallizing them inside the essence of material objects. Only in this way can they be molded according to need.
sources: Obtained from To Temper Thyself and Journey Far
Obtained from making offerings to the Tablet of Tona
Obtained from Tribal Secret Spaces in Natlan
Obtained from Joint Meeting Point Construction in Nod-Krai

105006.name: Dust of Enlightenment
105006.description:
The power of Artifacts stems from stories. Thus, sacred or profane writings may reshape them.
There is no good or evil inherent in stories, while songs and words have the power to save as well as destroy — such was the belief of the emissary who once conveyed revelations on the holiest one's behalf, governing the nations on earth and their glory, and who eventually fell from the high heavens. To this day, whether pure or impure, these feathers can still inscribe false revelations and rewrite fated tales, yet the only outcome of defying the world is to scatter into dust.
sources: Obtained from To Temper Thyself and Journey Far
Obtained at Kuuhenki's Hidden Trove in Nod-Krai
Obtained from Gnostic Hymn and Gnostic Chorus

107001.name: Anemoculus
107001.description: A substance that has accumulated intense Anemo energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107002.name: Elemental Dust
107002.description: Shattered fragments of the Oculus Crystal. Shows hidden treasure nearby.

107003.name: Geoculus
107003.description: A substance that has accumulated intense Geo energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107010.name: Crimson Agate
107010.description: A type of crystal formed from the combination of concentrated life force with an energy unique to Dragonspine. Makes for an ideal nutrient for growing Frostbearing Trees.

107011.name: Crimson Agate (Display)
107011.description: A type of crystal formed from the combination of concentrated life force with an energy unique to Dragonspine. Makes for an ideal nutrient for growing Frostbearing Trees.

107013.name: Vial of Adeptal Speed
107013.description: A small bottle that seals some adeptal energy within. Will immediately complete a furnishing when used.

107014.name: Electroculus
107014.description: A substance that has accumulated intense Electro energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107015.name: Moonchase Charm
107015.description: These jade talismans have been placed in various areas by the Adventurers' Guild. They are made from crystal-clear and gently lustrous Plaustrite Shards. It is said that these talismans contain the essence of the bright white moon and store the reminiscences that people have of festivals past.

107016.name: Lumenspar
107016.description:
A sky-blue crystal that glitters so brightly that it brings forth echoes of the heavens above, which cannot be seen from underground...
If you hold it up to your ear, you can almost hear a soft sigh coming from within.
This might sound strange, but this crystal also gives off a faint warmth.

107017.name: Dendroculus
107017.description: A substance that has accumulated intense Dendro energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107020.name: Match Invitation Letter
107020.description: You can select a player from the Player List via the invitation board, and then entrust The Cat's Tail to send out an invitation using this Invitation Letter. The invited player will head over to the tavern and wait for a duel with you.

107021.name: Lucky Coin
107021.description: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG.
