So he was all the more surprised when he received a gift from the fae of snow, who at the time had not yet taken their human form.
As far as he knew, he never told them that he was born from an egg as pale as ice deep within the wing-like mountains, nor did he ever mention the date of his birth.

114094.name: The Frost Emperor's Ceremony
114094.description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The fae of the court didn't understand why a gift meant for the Tsar must be made in such shape. They knew only to lavish their craft upon ornaments bright as jewels.
Only the Tsar seated upon the throne and the fae of snow understood the meaning behind it.
For what mattered was never the ceremony, but the ancient truth it preserved.

114095.name: The Frost Emperor's Lament
114095.description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
On the night the truth stirred like bitter waves, she prepared this gift for her friend upon the throne—though she herself was no longer the person she used to be.
They both seemed to understand that they might never speak to each other like this again.
For after that night, the path they once walked together diverged—sundered by the weakness of one, and the fury of the other.

114096.name: The Frost Emperor's Farewell
114096.description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
An object that appeared upon the table on the eve of war, though none knew when or how it'd come to be there.
He recognized it for the handiwork of the friend he hadn't seen for many long years.
Only then did he realize, that this was the beginning of every calamity, the bitter fruit of every desire, and the omen of every destruction.

116001.name: BEP
116001.description: Your travel diary contains all that you have experienced in your long journey. These experiences shall someday become the stuff of song.

118002.name: Cake for Traveler
118002.description:
A souvenir left over from a very special day.

Here's to you, the brightest star in the night sky.
Wishing you a joyous journey in this great big world.

"This must be the first time we've celebrated this special day. Every week, we update the recommended dishes, every month, the moon will send down new blessings, but wow, it's almost nine thousand hours to go before we celebrate this day again!"

118004.name: Cake for Traveler
118004.description:
A gift given to a very special someone on a very special day.

Here's to you, busy as you are in this land.
Wishing you a joyous journey in this great big world.

"Every week, the recommended dishes get updated. Every month, the moon sends down new blessings — but wow, it's going to be almost nine thousand hours more before we can celebrate this day again! And by that, Paimon means that she'll accompany you all the way, Traveler!"

118006.name: Cake for Traveler
118006.description:
A gift you obtained on a very special day.

Here's to you, traveler from beyond the mountains and seas.
Wishing you a joyous journey in this great big world.

"Every week, we update the recommended dishes, every month, the moon will send down new blessings, but wow, it's almost nine thousand hours to go before we celebrate this day again! Paimon will spend every day onward with you, whether it rains or shines, hehe!"

118008.name: Cake for Traveler
118008.description:
A gift given to a very special someone on a very special day.

Here's to you, the symphony and echoes amidst the verdant trees.
May you find happiness and peace in your sweet dreams.

"Recommended dishes will be updated on a weekly basis, and the moon will shower us with new blessings each month, but wow, it'll be almost nine thousand hours before we can celebrate this day again! Hee-hee, let Paimon play you the music from that score on top of the cake. You'd better not make fun of Paimon's performance, cus she's been practicing it for ages!"

118010.name: Cake for Traveler
118010.description:
A gift given to a very special someone on a very special day.

Here's to you, who listens to the song of the ocean tides with a tranquil heart.
Wishing you a joyous journey in this great big world.

"Every week, the recommended dishes get updated. Every month, the moon sends down new blessings — but wow, it's going to be almost nine thousand more hours before we can celebrate this day again! Just like Leisurely Otters are always accompanied by their seashells, Paimon will always be by your side!"

118012.name: Cake for Traveler
118012.description:
A gift given to a very special someone on a very special day.

Here's to you, gazing into the flickering campfire.
May you find warmth and happiness on your journey.

"Every week, the recommended dishes get updated. Every month, the moon sends down new blessings — but wow, it's going to be almost nine thousand more hours before we can celebrate this day again! The time we spent together is like chocolate — sweet, soft, and too good to be savored in one bite... Mmmm! You're Paimon's favorite travel partner!"

118014.name: Cake for Traveler
118014.description:
A gift given to a very special someone on a very special day.

Dedicated to you, who journey through moonlit shadows and endless forests.
May your journey across this world always be blessed with joy and surprises.

"Every week, the recommended dishes get updated. Every month, the moon sends down new blessings — but wow, it's going to be almost nine thousand more hours before we can celebrate this day again! Still, just like the moon rises every single day, Paimon will always be right here, traveling by your side! Yep, let's make wonderful memories wherever we go!"

120825.name: Angled Drop Bottle
120825.description:
A potion bottle with very distinctive angles, like a chiseled drop of water. When it comes to precious alchemical potions, not a single drop may be wasted...
It can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

120826.name: Heartstopping Heart Bottle
120826.description:
A potion bottle with a tall stem with a heart-shaped design. It is said that customers will find it aesthetically appealing no matter the color of the potion within...
It can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

120827.name: Tranquil Bay Bottle
120827.description:
A cleverly crafted bottle with a unique long neck design. They say that the designer of the bottle compared it to a "tranquil bay"...
It can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

120828.name: Gorgeous Gem Bottle
120828.description:
A potion bottle with a narrow mouth and wide body. The interweaving of a multitude of straight lines gives it the outward appearance of a large gemstone, bestowing it with an extra-luxurious look in the eyes of customers...
It can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

120829.name: Chonky Cat Bottle
120829.description:
A potion bottle with a round, curvy design, like a fat feline's head. The attention of customers who like cuteness is easily drawn to these bottles...
It can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

120830.name: Windwheel Aster's Aroma
120830.description: A bottle decoration made from the combination of a Windwheel Aster and emerald-green leaves. It seems to be able to envelop the potion in a gentle breeze...

120831.name: Resplendent as a Crystalfly
120831.description: An especially eye-catching bottle decoration fashioned in the shape of a Crystalfly that can sometimes grab the attention of customers in an instant...

120832.name: Perfect Gift Ribbon
120832.description: A bottle ornament that is shaped like a ribbon tied into a bow. It seems to give the potions a feeling similar to that of a gift box, bursting with promises of pleasant surprises...

120833.name: Raspberry-Red Flying Flower Feather
120833.description: A feather-shaped bottle ornament sprinkled with berry-red that is said to easily be associated by customers with the image of birds in flight...

120834.name: Gold Gild and Emerald
120834.description: A bottle ornament with a golden frame and the appearance of an emerald gem. The "gemstone" is made of glass, and balances aesthetic appeal with cost...

120835.name: Shop Decoration: Blooming Morale
120835.description: A decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop. A beautiful double-layered flower bed, it is said to have been donated by a certain member of the Investigation Team as a "morale booster."

120836.name: Shop Decoration: Blooming Atmosphere
120836.description: A decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop. An array of blue and beige colored flowers, it was supposedly created by a certain member of the Logistics Company as an "item to build up the atmosphere."

120837.name: Shop Decoration: Potent Potions
120837.description: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, it can be hung from the shop roof, and the pictured potion uses a classic shape that most people associate with...

120838.name: Shop Decoration: Portentous Potions
120838.description: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, it is also used to advertise the alchemy shop throughout Mondstadt. The pictured potion uses a classic shape that most people associate with...

120839.name: Shop Decoration: Prismatic Effects
120839.description: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, many small multicolored flags are hung from it, and the "prismatic" effect is said to be symbolic of the many myriad effects of the wondrous potions sold...

120858.name: Yellow Obsidian Fragment
120858.description: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Children of Echoes, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.
sources: Tequemecan Valley and Basin of Unnumbered Flames Exploration Reward

120859.name: Yellow Obsidian Ring
120859.description: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Children of Echoes. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

120875.name: Cultivation Area Expansion (VII)
120875.description: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

120876.name: Alchemeter
120876.description: A custom Knights of Favonius device used to analyze alchemical ingredients. Place any alchemical shop ingredients within to analyze their special characteristics and increase the corresponding "ingredient level," allowing the efficacy of concocted potions to be increased in various ways...

121253.description: A toolbox that once held Ineffa's accessory — an accessory that has since been taken.

121279.name: Krumkake Bolt
121279.description: A bolt engraved with the Krumkake Craftshop's logo. It may serve some purpose there.

Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Hiisi Island.

You found this strange module by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to open the secret hall within the Temple of Space.

121659.name: Remnant Incense Guide - Snowgrave
121659.description:
Gathering three pieces of the Remnant Incense Guide - Snowgrave allows you to unseal the vault of Shadow Realm at the Snowgrave.
Legend has it that early squads exploring the Shadow Realm would occasionally find themselves unable to retrieve the treasures they discovered. In such cases, they would leave a specific "scent trail" behind. Only by piecing together the incense trail can one track down the locations of these long-lost relics.
